Flashlight: Shines a beam of light that blinds the Killer when aimed at their face. Blinding the Killer while they carry a Survivor makes them drop that Survivor.
Fog Vial: Releases a Fog Cloud that hides Survivors inside it, suppressing Auras, Scratch Marks, and sound. Its charges recharge over time.
Key: Lets you see the Auras of other Survivors. Stronger Keys can also unlock Chests and the Hatch.
Map: Reveals the Auras of nearby Pallets and vaults, and can mark a spot that reveals the Auras of Generators around it.
Med-Kit: Heals other Survivors faster and lets you heal yourself, at a reduced speed.
Toolbox: Repairs Generators faster and lets you sabotage Hooks. Each use drains its charges.
